question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.session, i.stamp as input_stamp, c.stamp as confirm_stamp
FROM form_log i
JOIN form_log c ON i.session = c.session
WHERE i.path = '/regist/input' 
  AND c.path = '/regist/confirm'
  AND i.stamp < c.stamp
ORDER BY i.session, i.stamp

<parameter=sql>
WITH input_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_input_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
confirm_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) as first_confirm_stamp
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
),
valid_sessions AS (
    SELECT i.session
    FROM input_visits i
    JOIN confirm_visits c ON i.session = c.session
    WHERE c.first_confirm_stamp > i.first_input_stamp
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) as unique_sessions
FROM valid_sessions
</parameter>
